description: Record when an item left the house, without deleting its row.
rationale: Deleting a sold sofa loses what it cost and when it was bought, which is exactly what the inventory exists to remember. A nullable date is the whole change: nullable, because every row that exists today is still in the house and there is no value to backfill. Note what this does NOT do -- house.item_overview was created with its columns enumerated, so the new column does not appear there and will not until a replace_view says so.

intents.comment: When the thing left the house -- sold, given away, thrown out. Null while it is still here, which is what makes the partial index below small.

intents.name: item_disposed_on_idx
intents.comment: Partial: almost every row is still in the house, so the index covers only the ones that left.
